Class CashierApp

java.lang.Object
frontend.CashierApp
public class CashierApp extends Object
Cashier-facing Point-of-Sale (POS) UI.

Provides touch-friendly controls to create tickets made of combos and a-la-carte items, calculates totals and tax, validates and saves orders into the database, updates inventory quantities based on menu item ingredients, and records payments. It also exposes order history search and a link to the manager interface for authorized roles.
